summary: Join comprehensive training course on Renewable Energy Integration in oil and gas operations. Equip yourself with essential skills for a sustainable industry.
lede: Renewable energy integration in oil and gas operations involves evaluating power options for engineers, managers and facility teams. The course covers comparing solar, wind, geothermal, hydrogen and bioenergy; designing battery-storage hybrid systems; and assessing project economics, reliability and safety risks, with applications across upstream, midstream and downstream operations and business-case development.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals across the energy sector spectrum, from those involved in day-to-day operations to those shaping the strategic direction of their organizations in the face of the global energy transition.
audience: Oil and gas project managers and engineers
Finance professionals in energy investment decisions
modules: Introduction to Renewable Energy in Oil and Gas
Solar and Wind Applications in Industrial Energy Systems
Battery Storage and Hybrid Power System Design
Economic Evaluation and Energy Investment Modeling
Building and Presenting the Renewable-Integration Business Case
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of oil and gas operations and an interest in renewable energy. Prior experience in project management, engineering, or strategy is beneficial but not required.
